notes.title: The Slimekings Tower 1.5 Update coming out this 25th of May 2018!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sENxFrnU9zs
The Slimeking's Tower 1.5 update is coming this 25th of May 2018 introducing new content and features:
[list]
[*]Many secrets to discover.
[*]More than 50 new items.
[*]New enemies and bosses.
[*]New rooms, with bigger layouts.
[*]New zones to explore.
[*]New characters to unlock.
[*]Improved synergy between items.
[*]Overhaul UI and QOL changes.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.5 Update is coming!
notes.notes:
Hi there, slime slayers!

The 1.5 update of The Slimeking's Tower is almost finished and it will be available pretty soon. I don't want to throw spoilers yet but here's a small resume of what you can expect:

[list]
    [*]Online Multiplayer BETA.
    [*]New environments to explore.
    [*]New characters to unlock.
    [*]A new set of items to get and experiment with.
    [*]New enemies and bosses.
    [*]Several QOL upgrades and graphics updates.
    [*]New secrets to discover.
[/list]

...And that's only part of what's coming!

So let the train hype begin, and if you don't have a copy of the game yet, there's a 50% discount this week, so it's the perfect chance to get ready for the new update!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.12 [06/09/17]
notes.notes:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29416410/97d9e125130aea11821c4667ff02d96715d92dd1.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29416410/bad6047eaae4d0ac91e436d9d08439e03e0c085f.png[/img][/url]

[h1]LOCAL MULTIPLAYER[/h1][list]
[*]Now all players can use their own controller and the player [b]<1>[/b] is no longer forced to use the keyboard.
[*]When a secondary player loses connection with its controller, it will despawn.
[*]Holding [b]<START>[/b] button for [b]3 seconds[/b] will despawn the secondary player.
[*]A secondary player won't spawn randomly when pressing <START> anymore.
[/list]
[h1]CHANGES[/h1][list]
[*][b]Full controller support[/b]: You can now navigate through the game without the need of mouse and keyboard.
[*]Several bugfixes.[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.8
notes.notes:
[img]http://codemanu.pro/HOTFIX.png[/img]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Language can now be changed on game's properties on steam.
[/list]

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Decreased the speed bonus of "Explorer Belt" from 1 to 0.5.
[*]Hitbox mask of throwable skulls have been slightly decreased.
[/list]

[h1]RESOLVED ISSUES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Items can't be used in the pre-boss screen anymore.
[*]Screenshots can now be taken at any moment and not only in-game.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.4.6.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://codemanu.pro/HOTFIX.png[/img]
[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Every adventure run has now a fixed seed that can be used to replay the run.
[/list]

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Decreased default bullet speed from 5 to 3.5 to make range more valuable.
[*]Decreased default bullet shoot rate from 5 to 4.5.
[*]Bombs can now be pushed.
[/list]

[h1]RESOLVED ISSUES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Enemies that are pushed out of the room will now die instead of getting stuck.
[*]Touch controls disabled.
[*]Stairs mask has been reduced.
[*]Gangslime is now vulnerable when the gang has died.
[*]Using the item "Lazer Beam" could crash the game under certain circumstances.
[*]Game's window can now be resized and there's a fullscreen option in the ingame menu.
[*]Gamepads can now properly map the <Use item> button.
[*]Scroll wheel can now be used to navigate through item and pet lists.
[*]Escape function in the in-game menu will teleport you to the initial room.
[/list]
